text:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a canary for model-3.1 this week. Thinking percent-based + limited-region ramp. Draft config below, want 👀 on guardrails and rollback triggers before I flip the flag.
jia: thanks. what percent are you starting at?
alex: start 5% global, but only in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for the first 24h, then 20% in those regions if signals look good. full region ramp T+48h. open to adjustments.
sophie: can we tie automatic rollback to both latency and inference error spikes? suggested SLOs: p95 <= 150ms, error_rate <= 0.5%. If either breaches for X minutes -> rollback.
mike: add a safety window for peak hours — if we enter rollout during our traffic spike window, hold to 1% and require manual approval to move. also add canary tag for billing.
alex: agreed on both. also want KV-cache warmup pre-rollout (warm-prefix for top 10k prefixes) — will stage that 30m before percent increase.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: model artifact verified, canary policy present, alerts configured, experiment flag created, metrics dashboards linked.
alex: draft flag config (yaml):

```yaml
flag: model_3_1_canary
version: 2026-03-15
scope:
  regions: ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
  percent: 5
  allowlists:
    - internal-team
    - alpha-customers
slo:
  p95_latency_ms: 150
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
rollback_triggers:
  - name: high_latency
    condition: "p95 > 300"
    window_minutes: 5
  - name: error_spike
    condition: "error_rate > 1.5"
    window_minutes: 3
rollout_steps:
  - wait: 24h
  - bump_percent: 20
  - wait: 24h
  - ramp_regions: all
notes: "warmup: prefetch top prefixes 30m before bump"
```
jia: looks good. can you add a circuit-breaker that disables canary if infra CPU on serving nodes > 70% for 10m?
alex: done; will update config and push to console. question for SRE: do we have alert runbook linked to the flag for oncall?
mike: yes — add runbook id RB-331 in the flag metadata so pager includes remediation steps. also tag the rollout with `canary:fast-fail` so automatic fallback happens if any critical infra alert fires.
sophie: one more ask — include a small sample of golden prompts for quality regression checks. If regression score drops > 2 pts, auto-roll back.
alex: will attach eval set to the flag and wire the quality monitor. timeline: flip initial 5% tomorrow 09:00 UTC, will post status updates here. @jia @sophie @mike — anything blocking on your side?
jia: 👍 no blockers from infra side.
sophie: will finish eval set + dashboards by today EOD.
mike: I'll add RB-331 and set the circuit-breaker alert. schedule the warmup job 30m prior.
alex: great — thanks everyone. I'll create the flag and ping again once created. :thumbsup:
